response.sql: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq), above AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, o.overall_avg FROM eq CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE eq.avg_hum > o.overall_avg), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM above) SELECT a.equipref AS equipment_reference, a.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, a.avg_hum - a.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, a.avg_hum - g.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM above a CROSS JOIN grp g WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
